title: CSRF on state-changing actions
summary: Prove cross-site forged requests can change auth'd state without a valid anti-CSRF token.
steps: From the map, pick a state-changing form/API (password change, email update, transfer, admin action) that uses cookies.
Capture a legitimate request via capability map api_samples or replay_http_request.
Strip/blank CSRF token / custom header; replay cross-origin style (no token, different Origin/Referer).
compare_requests: legitimate vs forged; confirm state change (email updated, password set) not just HTTP 200.
If SameSite=Lax/Strict blocks classic CSRF, note it and try method override / JSON content-type edge cases only when observed.
On PASS: submit_finding_candidate with before/after evidence; queue_finding_followups(vuln_type='csrf').
pass_signals: Authenticated state changed without valid CSRF token
kill_signals: Token required and bound to session
SameSite + no alternative vector after disciplined probes
references: PortSwigger: Using Burp to Test for CSRF
